sentences.text:
Mohim Gorai @ Mahendra Gorai vs Unknown on 20 July, 2023
20.07.2023 C.R.M. (A) 2599 of 2023
 Sl. 32
Court No. 29
 Sourav

In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 (Allowed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Saltora Police
 Station Case No. 29 of 2023 dated 07.04.2023 under Sections
 498A/304B/302/34 Ipc.
 And

In the matter of: Mohim Gorai @ Mahendra Gorai
 ....petitioner.

Mr. S. S. Imam
 Mr. R. Jana
 ...for the State.

1 . 
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner is stated to be the uncle-in-law of the deceased.
3. It is fairly submitted at the Bar that there is no allegation of specific overt act against the petitioner who is stated to be residing in the same village in a separate house.
The deceased is stated to have committed suicide within seven years of her marriage.
4. The investigation is stated to have progressed substantially.

5. Regard being had to the facts and submission, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, nature of evidence and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail in the event of his arrest by the Arresting Officer in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
6. The petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O. within 21 days from today along with a server copy or certified copy of this order.
7. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
8. The application being CRM (A) 2599 of 2023 is disposed of.
